items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Buddy Petit came home, Faiso came home. So Tom won't play by the name of Ambrose, you might have heard of him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he looks short. By the way, you're talking about that tour, then we left and went to Galveston. We left and went to Galveston, Texas. We went to Houston, Texas. First we left here and went to Houston, Texas to play a job. And after we was in Houston for a while, then another guy came out to us and said he got a job for us to go to Galveston, Texas. So we went to Galveston, Texas. I'll never forget, we took a piano player from here with us, but after we got in, after we got out there in Texas, we found out…
Buddy Petit came home, Faiso came home. So Tom won't play by the name of Ambrose, you might have heard of him.
He's Lawrence Tucker's uncle. I can't locate him. He had his last name.
